integrity: The proof is symbolic and unbounded. A direct finite verifier checks the defining count and the local-product formula for ten representative prime-power indices through \(n=400\); those checks are regression evidence, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to prime-power cyclotomic indices \(m=\ell^a\ge3\). It does not classify composite non-prime-power cyclotomic indices or constant-ratio equations other than equality with Euler's totient.
title: Cyclotomic generalized totients coincide with Euler’s totient only on the underlying prime powers
